images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of SPARGen.Given a sequence of RGB images and a language instruction, SPARGen represents spatial outputs as sequences or image-aligned fields. These two output formats are generated through the native autoregressive and rectified-flow pathways of a shared MoT backbone. The dashed box denotes the training-only encoding of target fields.

Figure 2:Qualitative results of SPARGen on point map reconstruction, optical flow estimation, and depth estimation. For optical flow, we show the predictions and error maps before and after refinement.
